map.need: Create the event with name, dates, time zone, venue address, and event type (in-person, virtual, hybrid)
map.note: Name, short name, dates, time zone, venue and event type are typed on Content > Basics. The website header and footer, the agenda day tabs and the app home screen read them.

map.need: Upload logo, banner, and brand colors that apply to the event website, registration pages, emails, and mobile app
map.note: Tagline and support email reach the website. Colours save but nothing reads them. No logo or banner upload.

map.need: Publish a public event website with agenda, speakers, sponsors, venue, and ticket pages on a custom domain
map.note: The site is live with agenda, speakers, sponsors and tickets. Custom pages are now written from the dashboard. 9 pages still need a developer. No domain setting.

map.need: Keep the event in draft and preview it before publishing, with control over what is visible to the public
map.feature: Launch checklist, session Status, Hide ticket
map.note: Sessions and documents can stay draft and tickets can be hidden. There is no event-level draft or preview. Publish is a checklist, not a switch.

map.need: Clone a previous year's event as a starting template
map.note: Only one event exists. No clone.

map.need: Create, edit, and delete sessions with title, abstract, start and end time, room, track, session type, and tags
map.note: No delete. Set Status to cancelled instead.

map.need: Manage multiple parallel tracks and rooms across several days, with a grid view that flags room and speaker conflicts
map.feature: Track Manager, Logistics Center, Conflict Check
map.note: Clashes come as a list, not a grid. Rooms live under Content > Logistics Center, which an organizer would not guess.

map.need: Bulk import and export sessions and speakers by spreadsheet
map.feature: Import and export in Session Manager and Speaker Manager
map.note: Imported sessions arrive as drafts.

map.need: Maintain speaker profiles with photo, bio, title, company, and social links, linked to their sessions
map.note: No delete. Remove the speaker from their sessions instead.

map.need: Send speakers a self-service link to fill in their own bio, photo, and slides, and track who has completed it
map.note: A private link per speaker for their own bio, photo, links and slides, with a tracker of who has opened it and an approval step. The link is sent by hand until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Make last-minute schedule changes that update the website and app immediately and notify affected attendees
map.note: Edits reach the website and app at once. A notice is written for everybody who saved the session, and the job that delivers it is not switched on yet, so announce a change yourself.

map.need: Restrict sessions to certain ticket types (workshops, VIP), with capacity limits, sign-up, and waitlists
map.note: Caps, ticket eligibility, sign-up and the waitlist all work, and a seat is taken one at a time so two people cannot both get the last place. Waiting on the new access settings being published to the live event.

map.need: Attach slides, papers, and recordings to sessions
map.note: Links only, no file upload, and documents are event-wide rather than attached to a session. A speaker can add a slides link against each session they are on. No recordings.

map.need: Publish a call for papers form with custom fields, submission categories, file uploads, and an open and close date
map.feature: Open a call for abstracts, Form Builder
map.note: Call, dates, tracks, session types and custom fields work. No file upload field. No call exists on the live event yet.

map.need: Let submitters log in to edit or withdraw a submission before the deadline
map.note: Authors edit or withdraw through a private link, not a login. Not seen live because no call exists.

map.need: Assign submissions to reviewers manually or automatically, with conflict-of-interest exclusions and optional blind review
map.note: Manual and by-track assignment, conflict-of-interest exclusions and blind review all work.

map.need: Collect reviewer scores and comments against configurable criteria and see aggregate rankings per track
map.note: Criteria, scores, comments and a ranking by track all work, with the spread of scores and who has not finished. Reviewers reach it by a private link sent by hand until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Record accept, reject, and waitlist decisions and send decision emails in bulk from templates
map.note: Accept and reject save, one submission at a time. No waitlist decision. Email only reaches the account owner until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Convert accepted submissions into agenda sessions and speaker profiles without retyping
map.note: Reached from Session Manager, not from the call screen. List is empty until submissions are accepted.

map.need: Create multiple ticket types with price, quantity cap, sale window, and description (early bird, regular, student, workshop, virtual)
map.note: Tickets save and show on the website. Nobody can buy until a payment account is connected.

map.need: Accept card payments through a connected payment processor with payouts to the organizer's bank account
map.note: Waiting on a payment account. Checkout refuses every order and payouts show a dash.

map.need: Create discount codes with percent or fixed amount, usage limits, expiry, and restriction to specific ticket types
map.note: Waiting on a payment account. The form is hidden. A code cannot be limited to a ticket type.

map.need: Issue complimentary tickets and hidden or access-code tickets for speakers, sponsors, staff, and press
map.feature: Hide a ticket, Add an attendee, Sponsor passes
map.note: Hidden tickets work by private link. A free attendee can be added by hand under Attendees. Sponsor passes and access codes both wait on a payment account.

map.need: Issue full and partial refunds and cancel orders from the dashboard, with the capacity released back to inventory
map.note: Waiting on a payment account. Full refunds only, even once one is connected. A cancelled registration does give its seat back.

map.need: Generate invoices and receipts automatically with company name, billing address, and tax or VAT number, and allow reissue after edits
map.note: Waiting on a payment account. Invoices carry company name and billing email. VAT number is a free-text note. No reissue from the dashboard.

map.need: Support pay-by-invoice or bank transfer orders that can be marked paid manually
map.feature: Mark an invoice paid, 2.6 Offline Payment
map.note: Offline Payment works but lists exhibitor packages only and sits under Exhibitor Ticket Setup. Mark paid needs an invoice from the payment account.

map.need: Support group orders where one buyer purchases several tickets and assigns them to named attendees later
map.note: View only. Group orders are placed on the website with attendees named at purchase, not later, and wait on a payment account.

map.need: Configure tax rates and multiple currencies
map.note: Waiting on a payment account. Tax is set up there, not here. One currency. The menu label for this page is Pay > Publish, not Sales Tax.

map.need: Transfer a ticket to another person and upgrade or change ticket type after purchase
map.feature: Transfer a ticket, change ticket type
map.note: A ticket transfers to a named person with a fresh badge code, and a ticket type can be changed after purchase. The new holder is not emailed until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Sell add-ons such as workshops, dinners, and merchandise at checkout
map.note: The page only lists which tickets include workshops and video. Add-ons cannot be created or sold.

map.need: Build the registration form with custom questions (text, dropdown, checkbox, consent) and mark fields required
map.note: Text, choice, multi-choice and consent questions with a required flag all save and show at checkout. No answers can arrive until checkout works.

map.need: Show different questions depending on ticket type or a previous answer
map.note: A question can be limited to ticket types and shown only when an earlier answer matches. The same holds on the exhibitor and sponsor forms.

map.need: Capture terms acceptance, code of conduct agreement, and photo and data consent with a timestamp
map.note: Versioned forms record who signed and when, a required form blocks check-in and app access, and the signing link goes out by email once the event has its own sending address. No form exists on the live event.

map.need: Send an automatic confirmation email with ticket, QR code, and calendar file
map.note: Log only. The template cannot be edited and nothing can be resent. Email only reaches the account owner until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Collect dietary, accessibility, and visa invitation letter requests, and produce visa letters
map.note: Dietary and access needs can be asked as questions and the catering CSV exports them. No visa letters.

map.need: Create sponsor tiers and sponsor profiles with logo, description, links, and contacts, displayed by tier on the website and app
map.note: Sponsor profiles show by tier on the website, and tier names, their order and the logo size are all editable. A tier carries nothing else: complimentary passes are set per sponsorship ticket.

map.need: Manage exhibitor profiles with booth number, materials, and staff, plus a floor plan or booth map
map.note: Saves in the dashboard. The app keeps the old exhibitor list because the refresh job is not switched on. No floor plan image. Booth allocation is under Tickets, away from the exhibitor list.

map.need: Give sponsors and exhibitors a self-service portal to edit their own profile and manage their staff passes
map.note: No sponsor or exhibitor login. Speakers do have one.

map.need: Provide lead retrieval so exhibitors can scan attendee badges and export their leads
map.note: No badge scanning for exhibitors and no lead export.

map.need: Offer sponsored placements such as banners, sponsored sessions, and sponsored push notifications, with impression and click reports
map.note: The app has no banner slot. The page is a calculation.

map.need: Track sponsor deliverables and allotted complimentary tickets per sponsor
map.note: Free passes per package save. Issuing a pass waits on a payment account. There is now a report per sponsor of their tracked links, clicks and orders. Deliverables are still tracked as checklist tasks.

map.need: Send email campaigns to filtered segments (ticket type, registration status, speakers, sponsors) with merge fields
map.note: Email only reaches the account owner until the event has its own sending address. Sends to imported contact lists, not attendee segments. Plain text, no merge fields. Filed under Tickets, not Marketing.

map.need: Schedule emails in advance and save reusable templates
map.note: No scheduled send and no saved templates.

map.need: See delivery, open, click, bounce, and unsubscribe statistics per campaign
map.note: Sent, failed, bounced and unsubscribed are tracked. No opens or clicks.

map.need: Send from a verified organizer domain with a custom sender name and reply-to address
map.note: The event has no sending address of its own yet, and there is no screen for the sender name or the reply-to address.

map.need: Generate tracking links or referral codes to measure which channels and partners drive registrations
map.note: Links save and clicks count. Orders stay at 0 until checkout works.

map.need: Send automated reminders to abandoned checkouts and to invited people who have not registered
map.note: Lists abandoned checkouts. No reminder can be sent.

map.need: Search, filter, and view the full attendee list with ticket type, payment status, form answers, and check-in status
map.note: Rows show name, company, title and ticket. Search still matches the email address only.

map.need: Add, edit, and cancel attendees manually and import attendees in bulk by spreadsheet
map.feature: Add an attendee, Import attendees from CSV
map.note: Add, edit, cancel and import all work, and every change is in the audit log. Nobody added by hand is emailed a claim code until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Assign attendee categories or tags (speaker, sponsor, staff, press, VIP) that control access and badge design
map.note: Up to twenty categories with a colour, assigned by hand or by a rule on a ticket type, and shown on the list, the badge and the exports. A category set by hand is never overwritten by a rule.

map.need: Check attendees in by QR scan or name search from a phone or tablet, with multiple devices syncing in real time
map.note: Camera scanning needs Chrome or Edge. The screen now fits a phone.

map.need: Keep check-in working during poor or lost connectivity and sync when back online
map.note: Check-in writes go through the server. No offline mode.

map.need: Design badges with name, company, category, and QR code, and export print-ready files for bulk pre-print
map.note: Prints name, company, title, ticket, category and QR, 25 to a sheet from the browser. No designer and no print file export.

map.need: Print badges on demand at the desk for walk-ins and reprints
map.note: Reprints come from the same sheet printer. Nothing prints on check-in.

map.need: Register and take payment from walk-in attendees on-site
map.note: A walk-in can be added and checked in. No card payment at the desk.

map.need: Scan attendance per session to enforce workshop access and record session headcounts
map.feature: Check in for a day or a session, Session Self Check-in
map.note: Counts heads per session. The door does not refuse somebody without the right ticket, though signing up in the app does. The label says Self Check-in but staff do the scanning.

map.need: Offer a self-service check-in kiosk mode
map.note: Scanning works. The tablet stays signed in as an organizer and no badge prints.

map.need: Give attendees a mobile app and web app with the agenda, speakers, sponsors, maps, and a personal schedule
map.note: The app has agenda, people, sponsors, my schedule, documents and badge. It is not in the app stores, and the download button points to the tickets page.

map.need: Add custom content pages and documents: venue maps, floor plans, Wi-Fi, travel, FAQ, code of conduct
map.note: Pages with headings, lists and links are written from the dashboard and show on the website and in the app. Waiting on the new access settings being published to the live event. Still no file upload and no map.

map.need: Control which app sections and menu items are shown and in what order
map.note: App tabs are fixed. Custom pages appear in the app home section but cannot be reordered or hidden.

map.need: Limit app access to registered attendees, with login by registration email
map.note: Ticket holders sign in with a code sent to their email. A join code can be asked for at sign-in once the new access settings are published to the live event. Each new attendee still needs a hand-run step before the app shows anything.

map.need: Send push and in-app announcements to everyone or to a segment, immediately or scheduled
map.note: Posts to the app home screen and the public wall for everyone. Push is skipped on the live host. No segment, no schedule, no draft.

map.need: Allow attendee-to-attendee direct messaging and group chat, with the ability to turn it off
map.feature: App direct messages, Admin Settings switches
map.note: The app has one-to-one messages. No group chat. The off switch takes effect once the new access settings are published to the live event.

map.need: Moderate community content: review reports, remove posts and messages, and block or ban users
map.note: Posts and replies can be hidden or deleted, and a hidden reply stops showing in the app once the new access settings are published. Replies written before that change do not show at all until they are brought up to date. No report queue, no ban, and direct messages cannot be moderated.

map.need: Run a community board with topics such as meetups, job postings, ride sharing, and lost and found
map.note: Attendees post meet-ups, jobs, travel and lost and found in the app. Organizers can read and moderate but not post.

map.need: Run live polls in sessions and display results on the room screen
map.note: Create, open and close work, and a room screen counts votes as they arrive. In the app attendees still see the result only after Publish the count.

map.need: Run session Q and A with upvoting and moderator approval before questions appear
map.note: Approve, hide and mark answered work. Vote counts do not update. The manager is under Content while its backlog is under Tools.

map.need: Send session feedback ratings and an overall event survey, and see and export the responses
map.note: Session feedback is live with responses, and every answer downloads as a spreadsheet, one row per answer. Registration answers download one row per person.

map.need: Offer an attendee directory with profiles, interests, and search, with privacy opt-out per attendee
map.feature: App People tab with profile visibility toggle
map.note: Each attendee can hide themselves from the directory in the app. The dashboard switches for the directory still do nothing.

map.need: Let attendees book one-to-one meetings with each other and with exhibitors, with time slots and locations
map.note: Only the organizer books room slots. Attendees cannot request a meeting and nothing shows in the app.

map.need: Recommend people to meet based on interests or shared sessions
map.note: Shows shared interests to the organizer. Nothing is suggested to attendees.

map.need: Run gamification with points, a leaderboard, and challenges such as a booth passport contest
map.note: Not built. Passport Contest is counts only.

map.need: Provide a shared photo gallery with organizer moderation
map.note: Attendees cannot upload photos.

map.need: Attach a live stream to each session from an external provider (Zoom, YouTube, Vimeo, RTMP) and play it inside the platform
map.note: Sessions have no stream field and the app has no player.

map.need: Gate streams and recordings so only holders of the right ticket type can watch
map.note: No streams or recordings exist to gate. Documents can be limited by ticket type.

map.need: Publish session recordings for on-demand viewing after the session, with an access expiry date
map.note: No video hosting. Two ticket tiers advertise a video library that nothing serves.

map.need: Give remote attendees the same chat, Q and A, and polls as in-room attendees
map.note: No remote audience. App Q&A and polls work for anyone signed in, but there is no stream to watch.

map.need: Offer virtual sponsor booths with video, downloads, and live chat
map.note: Not built.

map.need: Report virtual attendance: viewers per session and watch time
map.note: No streams, so nothing to count.

map.need: See a live dashboard of check-in counts, by ticket type and by hour, during the event
map.note: A door screen shows how many people are in, split by ticket type and by hour, updating as the desk scans.

map.need: Create staff and volunteer accounts limited to check-in only
map.note: A team member can be given the check-in only role, which opens the door and nothing else, so a volunteer cannot download the attendee list. The invitation link is sent by hand until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Display digital signage for rooms showing current and next session
map.note: A screen per room shows what is on now and next, refreshes itself, and says when it last managed to.

map.need: Send an emergency broadcast by push and email to all attendees on-site
map.note: The plan shows in the app once marked ready. An announcement reaches the app home screen only. No push, no email. Filed under Virtual & Hybrid, where nobody would look during an incident.

map.need: Export attendees, orders, payments, refunds, and form answers to CSV or Excel at any time
map.note: Nine files download and the attendee and catering files are correct. Survey answers, session feedback and registration answers download as well.

map.need: View sales reports: revenue by ticket type, by day, by discount code, net of fees and refunds, reconcilable with processor payouts
map.feature: Orders and Transactions > Summary, Pay > Balance
map.note: Revenue by ticket type and day, refunds and a fee estimate. No split by discount code. Totals come from this event’s own orders and read $0 today.

map.need: View engagement reports: app adoption, session attendance, poll and survey results, messages, meetings, sponsor views and leads
map.note: App adoption, session attendance and survey results exist, ticket and company breakdowns read real numbers, and there is a report per sponsor of tracked links, clicks and orders. Sponsor profile views are not recorded anywhere.

map.need: Send post-event thank-you and survey emails, and issue certificates of attendance
map.note: Certificates print from the browser only and are not emailed. Email only reaches the account owner until the event has its own sending address.

map.need: Keep the app and content available after the event, and produce per-sponsor ROI reports
map.note: The window that closes the app works once the new access settings are published to the live event, and one save afterwards is what starts it. There is now a report per sponsor.

map.need: Invite team members with roles that limit access by area (finance, agenda, sponsors, check-in, review), with an audit log of changes
map.note: Team members are invited by email with roles for finance, agenda, sponsors, check-in and review, and every change is written to the audit log. The list sits under Attendees, where an organizer would not look for it.

map.need: Connect to outside tools: CRM, email marketing, Zapier or webhooks, a public API, single sign-on, and an embeddable agenda and ticket widget
map.note: Every integration page is a manual CSV guide. No API, webhooks, SSO or embeddable widget.

map.need: Meet data protection requirements: GDPR consent records, data export and deletion on request, and a published privacy policy
map.feature: Person data export and delete, Release & Consent Forms
map.note: Consent records, a privacy notice on the website, and a download and a delete of everything held about one person, with a plain list of what has to stay.
